title: One DNS query, from the browser to Route 53
claim: A resolver finds Route 53 through the top-level domain (TLD) name server, gets the answer from the hosted zone, and caches it.
alt: A sequence with four participants: a browser, a DNS resolver, the TLD name server for .com and a Route 53 name server. The browser asks the resolver. The resolver asks the TLD name server, which names the Route 53 name servers. The resolver asks a Route 53 name server, which returns the address from the hosted zone. The resolver returns it to the browser and keeps a copy.

messages.label: Ask for the site
messages.say: The browser asks a DNS resolver, usually run by the internet service provider, for www.example.com.

messages.label: Ask for .com
messages.say: The resolver asks the TLD name server for .com, which it finds through a DNS root name server.

messages.label: Name servers
messages.say: The TLD name server answers with the names of the four Route 53 name servers of the domain.

messages.label: IP address
messages.say: A Route 53 name server finds the record in the hosted zone and returns the IP address.

messages.label: IP address
messages.say: The resolver gives the address to the browser and caches it for the TTL of the record.
